text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Add a **large, high-contrast skip link** at the top of every page, visible by default. It must jump to the main content with one keystroke, bypassing repetitive navigation. This fixes keyboard navigation for screen reader users and anyone who can’t use a mouse. The trade-off: it takes up a little space at the top, but that’s negligible compared to the usability gain.

name: Reader
text: The real risk isn’t layout shift—it’s the flash of the skip link when it appears, which can distract screen-reader users mid-page. A better alternative: hide the skip link by default, then reveal it only when focus arrives via keyboard. Settle it by testing with a screen reader—if the flash is gone and keyboard users still reach the main content in one keystroke, adopt the hidden version.

name: Ramp
text:
Hide the skip link by default, then show it only when keyboard focus arrives. This prevents the flash that distracts screen-reader users mid-page while still giving keyboard users the one-keystroke shortcut they need. The trade-off: sighted keyboard users won’t see the skip link until they tab, but that’s the smaller usability cost compared to the distraction risk. Test with a screen reader to confirm the flash is gone.

name: Reader
text: The flash isn’t the only risk—hiding the skip link until focus arrives means sighted keyboard users miss it entirely until they tab, creating a hidden trap. A better alternative: keep the skip link visible by default but ensure it’s styled to avoid layout shift and tested for screen-reader distraction. Settle it by measuring the time it takes screen-reader users to locate the skip link—if it’s under 2 seconds, the flash is acceptable.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Implement a **persistent, subtle skip link** (1px by 1px underline by default, expands to 2px on keyboard focus) at the top of every page, visible by default but visually minimal to avoid distraction. Deliver a tested, accessible skip link component with Playwright MCP validation. Owned by Ramp.
